title: Travel Protection Standing against a Booking on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A travel protection policy standing against an air booking bears on the value the booking's lines leave under the Air Ticket Fare Brands terms. Two records are read, both belonging to the **Travel Protection Plans** product: the protection policy standing against this booking and whether it stands in force, and the plan under which that policy was issued and whether that plan carries a cancel-for-any-reason benefit. What the plan itself promises the traveller is not in question here; only what those two records show.

**Where a protection policy stands in force against the booking and the plan it was issued under carries a cancel-for-any-reason benefit.** The cancel-for-any-reason offset, being 0.35, is taken as a share off the value the booking's lines leave, because the insurer answers that part of the loss.

**Where a protection policy stands in force against the booking and the plan it was issued under carries no cancel-for-any-reason benefit.** The standard protection offset, being 0.15, is taken as a share off the value the booking's lines leave.

**Where no protection policy stands in force against the booking.** No protection offset is taken off the value the booking's lines leave. The cancel-for-any-reason benefit of any plan is then beside the point, the first limb of each of the two preceding terms being unmet.

| Protection policy against the booking | Cancel-for-any-reason benefit on the plan it was issued under | Offset taken off the value the booking's lines leave |
| --- | --- | --- |
| In force | Carried | 0.35 |
| In force | Not carried | 0.15 |
| Not in force | Either way | No offset taken |

**On a hypothetical figure.** Where the value the booking's lines leave is 1000.00 US dollars, an in-force policy on a plan carrying the cancel-for-any-reason benefit has 0.35 of that figure taken off it, being 350.00 US dollars; an in-force policy on a plan carrying no such benefit has 0.15 of it taken off, being 150.00 US dollars; where no policy stands in force, nothing is taken off on this account.
